sections.heading: Are Wind-Damaged Shingles Worth Replacing? The 25% Rule and Full Roof Replacement

c.v: Are wind damaged roof shingles worth replacing?

runs.v: Yes: a shingle with a broken seal has lost its wind resistance, so replacing damaged shingles restores long-term protection before the next storm damage peels more tabs. A targeted repair is appropriate when damage is limited to a few shingles.

c.v: What is the 25% rule in roofing?

runs.v: When wind damage covers more than about 25% of the roof, a full replacement usually makes more financial sense than another repair, because extensive wind damage may require a full roof replacement. Replacement is often recommended once an asphalt roof passes about 20 years of age, though slate lasts far longer.
